A.label: the landlord
A.description: Holds the deposit and has withheld some or all of it after move-out.

B.label: the tenant
B.description: Paid the deposit and disputes the amount withheld.

suggestedConditions: landlord provides an itemized list of deductions
tenant returns all keys, remotes, and access fobs
payment is sent within 14 days of settlement
both parties confirm the forwarding address on file

guidance.consent: Deposit disputes often follow a difficult move-out; keep the tone even and do not revisit fault.
guidance.shuttle: Keep the discussion on the deposit amount and documented deductions, not on how the tenancy ended.
